<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 1em; display: block; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">字数 334，阅读大约需 2 分钟</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="0" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 22.4px; display: table; padding: 0.5em 1em; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em auto 1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; text-shadow: 1px 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)" data-heading="true">如何在 Windows 中使用 Kimi CLI（PowerShell 版）</h1>
<blockquote style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: italic; padding: 1em 1em 1em 2em; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-radius: 6px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); background: rgba(247, 247, 247, 1); margin-bottom: 1em; border-bottom: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-top: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-right: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)">
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 1em; display: block; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">说明</strong>：本教程适用于 PowerShell 环境。如需在 WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) 中安装，请参考<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qxnm/p/19174747">如何在 Windows 中使用 Kimi CLI - 高宏顺 - 博客园</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="1" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">一、安装 uv（包管理器）</h2>
<h3 id="2" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">方法 1：官方一键脚本（推荐）</h3>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">1. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">以管理员身份打开 PowerShell</strong></li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">2. 执行以下官方脚本，自动下载最新版并配置 PATH：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="hljs code__pre highlighter-hljs" style="color: rgba(169, 183, 198, 1); background: rgba(40, 43, 46, 1); text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 0 !important" data-dark-theme="true"><code>irm&nbsp;https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1&nbsp;|&nbsp;iex</code></pre>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">3. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">关闭当前窗口，重新打开终端</strong>，验证安装：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="hljs code__pre highlighter-hljs" style="color: rgba(169, 183, 198, 1); background: rgba(40, 43, 46, 1); text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 0 !important" data-dark-theme="true"><code>uv&nbsp;--version</code></pre>
<blockquote style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: italic; padding: 1em 1em 1em 2em; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-radius: 6px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); background: rgba(247, 247, 247, 1); margin-bottom: 1em; border-bottom: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-top: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-right: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)">
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 1em; display: block; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">提示</strong>：如果本地已安装 uv，此脚本会直接覆盖为最新版，相当于更新操作。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h3 id="3" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">方法 2：手动安装（适用于离线或网络受限环境）</h3>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">1. 手动下载最新版 <code style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">uv-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip</code><br>下载地址：https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">2. 解压到无空格的目录，例如 <code style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">C:\tools\uv</code></li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">3. 将该目录添加到用户 PATH 环境变量（永久生效）：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="hljs code__pre highlighter-hljs" style="color: rgba(169, 183, 198, 1); background: rgba(40, 43, 46, 1); text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 0 !important" data-dark-theme="true"><code>[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"PATH",
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;$env:PATH&nbsp;+&nbsp;";C:\tools\uv",
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"User"
)</code></pre>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">4. 重新打开终端，执行 <code style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px">uv --version</code> 验证安装</li>
</ol>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 id="4" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">二、配置国内镜像加速（可选）</h2>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">设置环境变量让 uv 默认使用清华源：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre highlighter-hljs" style="color: rgba(169, 183, 198, 1); background: rgba(40, 43, 46, 1); text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 0 !important" data-dark-theme="true"><code>[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"UV_DEFAULT_INDEX",
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/",
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"User"
)</code></pre>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 id="5" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">三、安装 Kimi CLI</h2>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">安装 uv 后，执行以下命令安装 Kimi CLI：</p>
<pre class="hljs code__pre highlighter-hljs" style="color: rgba(169, 183, 198, 1); background: rgba(40, 43, 46, 1); text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 0 !important" data-dark-theme="true"><code>uv&nbsp;tool&nbsp;install&nbsp;--python&nbsp;3.13&nbsp;kimi-cli</code></pre>
<h3 id="6" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">验证安装</h3>
<pre class="hljs code__pre highlighter-hljs" style="color: rgba(169, 183, 198, 1); background: rgba(40, 43, 46, 1); text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 0 !important" data-dark-theme="true"><code>kimi&nbsp;</code></pre>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">如果打开了kimi说明安装正常，配置可以参考之前发的文章</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qxnm/p/19174747">如何在 Windows 中使用 Kimi CLI - 高宏顺 - 博客园</a></p>
